# Just Vertical Commercial

> Just Vertical Commercial designs and manufactures modular hydroponic systems and custom indoor farms for commercial growers, institutions, and businesses.

Founded in 2016 in Toronto by Conner Tidd and Kevin Jakiela, Just Vertical develops patented hydroponic technology and provides end-to-end indoor farming solutions including design, installation, and maintenance. The company serves diverse sectors from schools and restaurants to government projects and real estate developers.

## Key Topics

- Vertical Farming
- Hydroponic Systems
- Indoor Farming

## Core Products

- [Container Farms](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/container-farm): Modular hydroponic system for 6,600 plants in a standardized container.
- [Standalone Grow Wall](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/standalone-grow-wall): Plug-and-play system for 88 plants indoors with integrated controls.
- [Free Standing Grow Rack](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/free-standing-grow-rack): Compact hydroponic system designed for small spaces.
- [Tropical Green Wall](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/tropical-wall): Decorative living plant wall system with LED lighting for interior spaces.
- [Custom Indoor Farm](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/custom-indoor-farm): Tailored indoor farm design service for any space and use case.

## Industry Solutions

- [Indoor Farms for Restaurants](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-food-services): Farm-to-table indoor farming systems for restaurants and food services.
- [Indoor Farms for Schools](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-education): Indoor farming solutions for schools and STEM education programs.
- [Indoor Farms for Long-Term Care](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-long-term-care): Biophilic indoor farms for care homes with wellness and therapeutic benefits.
- [Indoor Farms for Offices](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-offices): Indoor farming and green walls for office wellness and sustainability.
- [Indoor Farms for Commercial Growers](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-farmers): Indoor farming systems for commercial growers and farm diversification.
- [Indoor Farms for Real Estate Developers](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-building-projects): Indoor farming integration for real estate and construction projects.
- [Indoor Farms for Government Projects](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-government-projects): Indoor farming for government and municipal food security initiatives.
- [Indoor Farms for Nonprofits](https://commercial.justvertical.com/pages/indoor-farming-for-not-for-profits): Affordable indoor farming solutions for nonprofits and community food security.
